primary_phonetics_source.author: Rajesh Khatiwada
primary_phonetics_source.title: Nepali
primary_phonetics_source.paraphrase: Khatiwada reports contextual/speaker variation in the vowel often called schwa, alveolar Nepali affricates, and phonation/F0 effects after aspirated consonants. This supports phone-conditioned prosody analysis and explicit native-variation modeling; it does not validate this detector or provide Hindi-error labels.

next_implementation_requirements: Calibrate missing dental/affricate contexts on actual regional recordings; do not equate different IPA symbols merely to increase apparent coverage.
Condition local pitch/phonation comparisons on phone class, word/phrase position and intended reference style.
Keep broad observed native variation and preferred TTS style separate from Hindi-counterfactual evidence.
Evaluate prospective independent real word errors and intonation labels; model-source or G2P-request labels remain weak supervision.
